text: repairMbox documents Promise<object>, and its inner Promise resolves e.data on success. The async wrapper awaits that Promise but does not return it, so its resolved public value is undefined. Scoped documentation/API recommendation: return the data if callers need it, or state that the function only signals completion. Current FolderCommands only awaits completion.
